message: 浮き上がる疑念と暗雲

name: Synn
message: 「Morning, Azel!」

name: Azel
message: 「Hey」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry! I'm in a bit of a rush, so catch you later」

name: Synn
message: 「Awesome! Scored the mega-sized cabbage bread!!」

name: Azel
message: 「Hey」

name: Synn
message: 「Rare to see you here when it's so crowded, Azel. Sorry though! I've got something to take care of, see ya!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Classes are done, see you tomorrow!」

name: Azel
message: 「Hey」

name: Synn
message: 「You should try joining a club or something too, Azel. Seize that sparkling school life. Later!」

name: Azel
message: 「To think I would fall into such a predicament......」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Looks like Azel-chan finally understands how it feels to be left behind~」

name: Azel
message: 「What are you talking about?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Didn't you want to talk with Synn-kun?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I can see right through everything~」

name: Azel
message: 「Action. I have no choice but to make a move now......」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Azel-chan?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If you're looking for Synn-kun, I think he's probably in the Student Council room~」

name: Azel
message: 「The Student Council room, you say......?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Synn-kun. You're wearing a costume on the day of the event, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, yes」

name: Ria
message: 「It might be a good idea to leave some hangers or something in the restrooms」

name: Synn
message: 「I see! Good catch!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ow-ow-ow!」

name: Misa
message: 「Come on, stand up. Let's take it again from the top」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, dancing's impossible for me!! It's totally not my style!」

name: Misa
message: 「This much is basic etiquette for a young lady. Keep at it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Vice President sure is strict~~」

name: Misa
message: 「You're up next, Lolotte」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm going to have my kind Senpai teach me, so I'm fine」

name: Misa
message: 「No, you won't! You need to follow the proper steps first and learn to dance well enough so you don't embarrass Sister!」

name: Ria
message: 「A-ahaha...\s02」
I'd better learn the bare minimum too before having Senpai teach me.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, well this is rare. What's up?」

name: Azel
message: 「Where is Synn Sakura?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura?」

name: Azel
message: 「I'll be waiting at Finis Tower」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you planning to do somewhere so deserted?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Could this be a confession of love--!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, there's no way it's that」

name: Azel
message: 「I'll be waiting」
This feeling... it reacted to magical energy!?

name: Ria
message: 「Synn...」

name: Synn
message: 「Could Azel be a Demon too...?」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「I just felt it. That same sensation from when a Demon appears...」

name: Ria
message: 「Are you saying Azel went out of his way to let us know about that?」
Was that some kind of message?
No... I can't imagine Azel using such a roundabout method.

name: Ria
message: 「Me too, actually. I've been a little worried about Azel lately.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel is calling me... Just what for...?」

name: Ria
message: 「Let's report this to my sister... to Melilot.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. And then let's all go together.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see. So everyone is going to cheer Azel on for his confession.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's not it, Lolotte\s02」

name: Bylous
message: 「Can you win on your own?」

name: Bylous
message: 「On top of the ones who defeated Soltia, even that Nive might show up.」

name: Azel
message: 「What of it?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Why are you in such a rush?」

name: Azel
message: 「I am in no rush.」

name: Bylous
message: 「You still have plenty of time left to fulfill your objective, don't you?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Don't tell me you intend to get in my way?」

name: Azel
message: 「Hmph...」

name: Azel
message: 「I have nothing to say to you.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Then you're going to take his place instead, aren't you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!!」

name: Ria
message: 「That person is...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Bylous!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Get away from Azel, Bylous!!」

name: Bylous
message: 「So you've come, Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「You knew I was coming」

name: Ria
message: 「What Synn sensed earlier was...」

name: Bylous
message: 「A predictable reaction. With this, I can meet the Demon Lord anytime」

name: Melilot
message: 「Bylous... what on earth are you thinking?」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, are you okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't concern yourself with me」

name: Synn
message: 「Bylous isn't an ordinary person. It's dangerous, so stay back」

name: Azel
message: 「I said don't concern yourself with me!」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't do that!」

name: Bylous
message: 「Why try to protect someone you could just leave alone」

name: Synn
message: 「It's just my nature not to leave people alone. Especially when it's a friend」

name: Azel
message: 「...A friend, you say?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please answer my question, Bylous. What is your objective!?」

name: Bylous
message: 「...Shut up」
An overwhelming aura of intimidation so intense that just a glare sends chills down my spine.
Even Melilot is being overwhelmed...?
Still, like hell I'm turning tail and running away like this!

name: Ria
message: 「Azel. Hurry to somewhere safe--」

name: Azel
message: 「S-shut up! Don't touch-ugh」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel?!」

name: Azel
message: 「Disappear!! Ah, guh, guuh...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...」

name: Bylous
message: 「So your half-baked resolve is at war with itself」

name: Azel
message: 「W-what are you talking about...!」

name: Bylous
message: 「In such a state, you wouldn't even measure up to the current Demon Lord」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't mess with me!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Leave Bylous to us!! So Azel, you--」

name: Azel
message: 「As if the likes of you could stand against him...! Leave at once!!」

name: Bylous
message: 「Hmph...」
I can't sense any will to fight from Bylous.
Eyes full of disdain, as if watching a farce. And a gaze of curiosity directed at me.
He doesn't answer what he's thinking, nor do we have any means of forcing it out of him.
Bylous speaks dispassionately, offering only the bare minimum of words required by his own ambitions.
I'm convinced that all we can do right now is find the truth in the midst of battle.
However, we can't just leave Azel behind in agony and pick a fight.

name: Bylous
message: 「I look forward to the next time we meet」

name: Melilot
message: 「W-wait... Bylous」
Her faint voice couldn't stop Bylous, and all we could do was watch his imposing figure walk away.
An unimaginably fierce conflict is inevitable.
The reason Melilot, who relentlessly pursues the truth, didn't make a move was probably because there was no chance of winning.
In the end, even after defeating Soltia, not a single problem had actually been solved.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel... are you okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Don't touch me. I can walk on my own」
Azel, too, maintains his usual aloof demeanor as he disappears.
Yet, I felt as though the confidence I always caught glimpses of in his retreating back had grown faintly clouded.
